name: zk-proof-certificates
description: Privacy-preserving bulk degree certificate generation and verification system using Zero-Knowledge Proofs

scripts.compile-circuits: cd circuits && mkdir -p circuit_builds && circom certificate_simple.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l ../node_modules --output circuit_builds && cp circuit_builds/certificate_simple.r1cs ./certificate_simple.r1cs && cp circuit_builds/certificate_simple_js/certificate_simple.wasm ./certificate_simple.wasm
scripts.setup-ptau: cd circuits && snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 14 pot14_0000.ptau && snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot14_0000.ptau pot14_0001.ptau --name="First contribution" -e="random text" && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot14_0001.ptau pot14_final.ptau -v
scripts.generate-keys: cd circuits && mkdir -p ../keys && snarkjs groth16 setup certificate_simple.r1cs pot14_final.ptau certificate_simple_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute certificate_simple_0000.zkey certificate_simple_0001.zkey --name="First contribution" -e="Another random text" && cp certificate_simple_0001.zkey ../keys/certificate_simple.zkey && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey certificate_simple_0001.zkey ../keys/verification_key.json
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run node" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"

author: ZK Certificate Team
